metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to Chrome password manager via 3-dot menu > Passwords and autofill > Google Password Manager in 4 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome 3-dot menu, navigate submenus, access internal chrome:// pages, interact with Chrome settings UI.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests Chrome internal page navigation to bookmark manager, accessible via 3-dot menu > Bookmarks and lists, a different menu path from the original.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to chrome://bookmarks. Evaluator uses is_expected_active_tab_approximate to check active tab URL matches chrome://bookmarks.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's address bar via accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify bookmark manager is open.
goto_prefix is correctly set to empty string since chrome:// URLs already include their scheme; the default https:// prefix would produce an incorrect URL.
Metric (is_expected_active_tab_approximate) correctly handles string input from getter and compares against expected URL chrome://bookmarks after stripping query parameters.
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly as the 'rule' parameter and accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'] without wrapping.
Single-step instruction (open bookmark manager) is fully covered by single URL check — complete verification coverage.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The metric strips query parameters but not trailing slashes. Chrome may internally redirect chrome://bookmarks to chrome://bookmarks/, which could cause a false negative. Consider using is_expected_url_pattern_match with a regex pattern instead, or ensure the expected URL accounts for a possible trailing slash.
